pageDescription: Drop in code or text and get a clean, shareable link. Pick a language, set an optional expiry or view limit, and lock it behind a password if you need to.
metaDescription: Share code and text with syntax-aware links, expiry, view limits, and password protection.
successDescription: Your paste is live. Share the link below.
contentPlaceholder: Paste your code or text here…
title: Title
viewsInvalid: Enter a number of views: 1 or more.
viewLimitDesc: The paste stops working once the budget is spent.
viewLimitCounts: One view is spent every time somebody opens the link: the page itself, the raw text or a download.
viewLimitDoesNotCount: Thumbnails and previews in your dashboard do not count, and neither do your own visits as the owner.
viewsOwnerExempt: Opening it yourself is free: the owner and admins never spend a view.
helperText: Stored as a viewable, shareable upload - with expiry, view limits and passwords built in.
